newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-NEW ZEALAND WIN TOSS AND OPT TO BAT V INDIA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NEW ZEALAND WIN TOSS AND OPT TO BAT V INDIA.

text.p: New Zealand captain Stephen Fleming won the toss and elected to bat in a four-nation Independence Cup one-day cricket match against India on Wednesday.
India - Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Saurav Ganguly, Rahul Dravid, Vinod Kambli, Ajay Jadeja, Robin Singh, Nayan Mongia (wicket-keeper), Anil Kumble, Sunil Joshi, Venkatesh Prasad, Abey Kuruvilla.
New Zealand - Stephen Fleming (captain), Nathan Astle, Bryan Young, Matt Horne, Chris Cairns, Adam Parore (wicket-keeper), Gavin Larsen, Heath Davis, Dipak Patel, Chris Harris, Andrew Penn.
